summary: Okanogan NF lookout near Conconully: 1914 tree platform, 1943 L-4 cab on 40 ft tower, NHLR-registered 2000. Sources disagree on 2021 fire damage to the crow's nest.

facts.design: L-4 cab with catwalk on a 40-foot treated timber tower; earlier L-5 ground cab added 1935
facts.status_note: Tower survived the August 2021 Muckamuck fire; sources disagree on whether the 1914 crow's nest platform survived.

access.note: 2017 visitor: public access allowed, but catwalk missing many planks and stairs missing steps; keep-out sign at top of stairs. Summit road gated at times; walk to summit is 1.9 miles from the gate.

visit.trail_note: Driving to the summit is possible if the gate is open and the vehicle is high-clearance; otherwise hike 1.9 miles. The 2017 account describes unsafe stairs and catwalk.

events.note: Tree platform first established; NHLR and firelookout.com date the start to 1914
Current L-4 cab with catwalk placed on a 40-foot treated timber tower
Mrs. Harry A. Gavin of Omak completed a 99-day season; 1,171 total days as lookout; eleven summers
Award to Mrs. Mabel M. Gavin for thirteen seasons as lookout on Funk Mountain
Newspaper report that the lookout is manned
NHLR registration date November 8, 2000 as US 361, WA 42
Returned to service by Okanogan National Forest after sporadic use; staffed full time in 2000
Muckamuck fire, started August 4, burned around the summit. Sources disagree on whether the tower and the crow's nest survived.

corrections.proposed: 1914 tree platform first established; 1935 ground L-5 cab; 1943 current L-4 cab on 40-foot tower
corrections.why: NHLR says the site was first established as a tree platform in 1914, and the 1943 cab replaced an earlier cab. A 1943 build date alone omits the 1914 start.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: TrailChick (2017 visit, 2021 drive-by) says the summit burned and the lookout survived while the 1914 crow's nest appears lost. Okanogan Country says the tower narrowly escaped. The undated firelookout.com page calls the crow's nest still there, so it is probably older than the fire. The story reports both accounts.
NHLR gives 5,070 ft (1,545 m). firelookout.com gives 5122 ft and TrailChick and Okanogan Country give 5,121 ft. The record's 1545.3 m follows NHLR, which is kept.

notes_for_editor: Current staffing and rental status not found in sources read. The most detailed account is TrailChick's 2017 visit with a 2021 drive-by. The 1957 'Mrs. Harry A. Gavin' and 1960 'Mabel M. Gavin' items are linked to Mabel Gavin of the 1952 listing by inference only; the story says 'appear to'. Search budget: three WebSearch calls used against a budget of two.
